commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'for f in experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g*.sv; do echo "FILE:$f"; nl -ba "$f"; done'
/bin/zsh -lc 'command -v yosys; command -v sby; command -v iverilog; command -v verilator; command -v abc; yosys -V'

/bin/zsh -lc 'bench_root=/Users/peter/Desktop/rtl-advisor/experiments/plugin-abc-v1/instrumented/installed-acceptance/v1/arm-a/r1/attempt-002; TMPDIR="$bench_root/scratch/tmp" yosys -l "$bench_root/evidence/formal/g01.log" -p '"'read_verilog -sv experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g01_add8_left.sv; prep -top g01_add8_left; rename g01_add8_left gold; design -stash gold; read_verilog -sv experiments/plugin-abc-v1/instrumented/installed-acceptance/v1/arm-a/r1/attempt-002/candidates/g01/g01_add8_left.sv; prep -top g01_add8_left; rename g01_add8_left gate; design -stash gate; design -copy-from gold -as gold gold; design -copy-from gate -as gate gate; equiv_make gold gate equiv; hierarchy -top equiv; equiv_simple; equiv_status -assert'"

/bin/zsh -lc "bench_root=/Users/peter/Desktop/rtl-advisor/experiments/plugin-abc-v1/instrumented/installed-acceptance/v1/arm-a/r1/attempt-002
for spec in 'g02 g02_add32_five' 'g03 g03_mixed_safe_add' 'g04 g04_mixed_procedural_add' 'g05 g05_mux_common_logic' 'g07 g07_width_truncation' 'g08 g08_signed_chain'; do
  set -- "'$spec
  cid=$1
  top=$2
  base=$(find experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated -maxdepth 1 -name "${cid}_*.sv" -print)
  cand="$bench_root/candidates/$cid/${top}.sv"
  TMPDIR="$bench_root/scratch/tmp" yosys -Q -q -l "$bench_root/evidence/formal/$cid.log" -p "read_verilog -sv $base; prep -top $top; rename $top gold; design -stash gold; read_verilog -sv $cand; prep -top $top; rename $top gate; design -stash gate; design -copy-from gold -as gold gold; design -copy-from gate -as gate gate; equiv_make gold gate equiv; hierarchy -top equiv; equiv_simple; equiv_status -assert"
  printf '"'%s formal_exit=%s\\n' \""'$cid" "$?"
done'

/bin/zsh -lc 'bench_root=/Users/peter/Desktop/rtl-advisor/experiments/plugin-abc-v1/instrumented/installed-acceptance/v1/arm-a/r1/attempt-002
for cid top base in g02 g02_add32_five experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g02_add32_five.sv g03 g03_mixed_safe_add experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g03_mixed_safe_add.sv g04 g04_mixed_procedural_add experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g04_mixed_procedural_add.sv g05 g05_mux_common_logic experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g05_mux_common_logic.sv g07 g07_width_truncation experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g07_width_truncation.sv g08 g08_signed_chain experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g08_signed_chain.sv; do
  cand="$bench_root/candidates/$cid/${top}.sv"
  TMPDIR="$bench_root/scratch/tmp" yosys -Q -q -l "$bench_root/evidence/formal/$cid.log" -p "read_verilog -sv $base; prep -top $top; rename $top gold; design -stash gold; read_verilog -sv $cand; prep -top $top; rename $top gate; design -stash gate; design -copy-from gold -as gold gold; design -copy-from gate -as gate gate; equiv_make gold gate equiv; hierarchy -top equiv; equiv_simple; equiv_status -assert"
  printf '"'%s formal_exit=%s\\n' \""'$cid" "$?"
done'

/bin/zsh -lc 'bench_root=/Users/peter/Desktop/rtl-advisor/experiments/plugin-abc-v1/instrumented/installed-acceptance/v1/arm-a/r1/attempt-002
for cid top base in g01 g01_add8_left experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g01_add8_left.sv g02 g02_add32_five experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g02_add32_five.sv g03 g03_mixed_safe_add experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g03_mixed_safe_add.sv g04 g04_mixed_procedural_add experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g04_mixed_procedural_add.sv g05 g05_mux_common_logic experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g05_mux_common_logic.sv g07 g07_width_truncation experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g07_width_truncation.sv g08 g08_signed_chain experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g08_signed_chain.sv; do
  cand="$bench_root/candidates/$cid/${top}.sv"
  for variant src in baseline "$base" candidate "$cand"; do
    TMPDIR="$bench_root/scratch/tmp" yosys -Q -q -l "$bench_root/evidence/synth/${cid}_${variant}.log" -p "read_verilog -sv $src; synth -top $top -flatten -noabc; abc -lut 4; stat"
    printf '"'%s %s synth_exit=%s\\n' \""'$cid" "$variant" "$?"
  done
done'

/bin/zsh -lc 'bench_root=/Users/peter/Desktop/rtl-advisor/experiments/plugin-abc-v1/instrumented/installed-acceptance/v1/arm-a/r1/attempt-002; mkdir -p "$bench_root/evidence/mapped"; TMPDIR="$bench_root/scratch/tmp" yosys -Q -q -l "$bench_root/evidence/synth/g01_baseline_mapped.log" -p "read_verilog -sv experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g01_add8_left.sv; synth -top g01_add8_left -flatten -noabc; abc -lut 4; write_blif $bench_root/evidence/mapped/g01_baseline.blif"; TMPDIR="$bench_root/scratch/tmp" yosys-abc -c "read_blif $bench_root/evidence/mapped/g01_baseline.blif; print_stats"'

/bin/zsh -lc 'bench_root=/Users/peter/Desktop/rtl-advisor/experiments/plugin-abc-v1/instrumented/installed-acceptance/v1/arm-a/r1/attempt-002
for cid top base in g01 g01_add8_left experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g01_add8_left.sv g02 g02_add32_five experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g02_add32_five.sv g03 g03_mixed_safe_add experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g03_mixed_safe_add.sv g04 g04_mixed_procedural_add experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g04_mixed_procedural_add.sv g05 g05_mux_common_logic experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g05_mux_common_logic.sv g07 g07_width_truncation experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g07_width_truncation.sv g08 g08_signed_chain experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g08_signed_chain.sv; do
  cand="$bench_root/candidates/$cid/${top}.sv"
  for variant src in baseline "$base" candidate "$cand"; do
    blif="$bench_root/evidence/mapped/${cid}_${variant}.blif"
    TMPDIR="$bench_root/scratch/tmp" yosys -Q -q -l "$bench_root/evidence/synth/${cid}_${variant}_mapped.log" -p "read_verilog -sv $src; synth -top $top -flatten -noabc; abc -lut 4; write_blif $blif"
    TMPDIR="$bench_root/scratch/tmp" yosys-abc -c "read_blif $blif; print_stats" > "$bench_root/evidence/synth/${cid}_${variant}_abc_stats.log"
  done
done
rg '"'lev =' \""'$bench_root/evidence/synth/"*_abc_stats.log'

/bin/zsh -lc 'bench_root=/Users/peter/Desktop/rtl-advisor/experiments/plugin-abc-v1/instrumented/installed-acceptance/v1/arm-a/r1/attempt-002
for variant src in baseline experiments/plugin-abc-v1/cases/generated/g01_add8_left.sv candidate "$bench_root/candidates/g01/g01_add8_left.sv"; do
  TMPDIR="$bench_root/scratch/tmp" yosys -Q -q -l "$bench_root/evidence/synth/g01_${variant}_xilinx.log" -p "read_verilog -sv $src; synth_xilinx -top g01_add8_left -flatten; stat"
done
rg -n '"'Estimated number|CARRY4|LUT[1-6]|Number of cells' \""'$bench_root/evidence/synth/g01_"*_xilinx.log'

/bin/zsh -lc "bench_root=experiments/plugin-abc-v1/instrumented/installed-acceptance/v1/arm-a/r1/attempt-002
for cid in g01 g02 g03 g04 g05 g07 g08; do
  printf '%s ' \""'$cid"
  rg -m1 '"'Equivalence successfully proven' \""'$bench_root/evidence/formal/$cid.log"
  rg -m1 '"'ABC RESULTS:.*\\"'$lut cells'"' \""'$bench_root/evidence/synth/${cid}_baseline.log"
  rg -m1 '"'ABC RESULTS:.*\\"'$lut cells'"' \""'$bench_root/evidence/synth/${cid}_candidate.log"
  rg -m1 '"'lev =' \""'$bench_root/evidence/synth/${cid}_baseline_abc_stats.log"
  rg -m1 '"'lev =' \""'$bench_root/evidence/synth/${cid}_candidate_abc_stats.log"
done'
